content: Isa edde hibar báiyain okkol
In okkol bade, Isa Galilot gurafira gorer. Hiba Ehudiyat zaito no sa, kiyollahoile Ihudi neta okkole hibare marifelaibar kušišot aššil.
Ar hẽtte Ihudi bãša id (ziyanore Sukkut ho) hãsa hãsi aššil,
Isar báiyainde hibare hodde, "Enttu Ehudiyat zagoi, toi zene tui gorodde he ham okkol tor sahabi okkole deki fare.
Kiyollahoile ze nize mainšor muntu forhaš oito sa, hite gufone hono kissu no gore. Tui zehon in okkol goror, nizore duniyair sarme forhaš gor."
Kiyollahoile hibar nizor báiyainde o hibare biššaš no gorito.
Henot Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãr ṭaim ehono nu aiye, kintu tũwarar ṭaim hamiša hazir.
Duniyaiye tũwarare hingša gori no fare, kintu hiyane ãre hingša gore, kiyollahoile ãi hiyanor babute goba di ze hiyanor ham horaf.
Idot tũwara zo; ãi ehon no zaiyum, kiyollahoile ãr ṭaim ehono furon no o."

content: Hibaye hitarare in okkol hoiyore hiba Galilot taigiyegoi.
Kintu hibar báiyain okkol uwore idot giyegoi, bade hiba nize o heṛe giye, tarfore o kulasa bafe no, gufone.
Idot Ihudi neta okkole Isare tuwail, ar hodde, "Hite hoṛe?"
Ar heṛe mainšor dolor butore hibar babute bout monmonani šuru oiye, kissuye hodde: "Hiba bala." Ar kiye hor, "No, hite mainšore bul fõtot loizargoi."
Kintu Ihudi neta okkolor ḍore honokiye hibar babute kulasa bafe kissu no ho.
Idot Isar šikka
Id ada adi oiyede ṭaimot Isa uwore dormogórot giye, edde šikka diya šuru goijje.
Henot Ihudi neta okkol tajjuf oiyore hodde, "Hono šikka no gori kengori ite endilla giyan zane?"
Isaye hitarare zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãr šikka ãr nizor no, kintu ze ãre defeṛaiye, hibar.
Ze honokiye hibar issa falon goribolla issa gore, hite ei šikkar babute zanibo, iyan Allattu or ne naki ãi nizottu hoi.
Hite ze nizottu ho hite hitar nizor tarif tuwa, kintu hite ze defeṛaiyede hibar tarif tuwa, toile hite soiyi, na soiyi hitar butore nai.
Musaye ki tũwarare ain no de ne? To tũwarar honokiye he ain falon no gore; tũwara ãre kiyolla marifelaito sor?"

content: Manuš okkole zuwabe hodde, "Tore bute faiye, tore marifelaito hone sar?"
Isaye zuwabe hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi ekkan ham goijji, ar tũwara beggune ammuwak oiyo.
Ar Musaye tũwarare azomi goraibar niyom dil, (zodi o ei niyom asole Musar hãsottu nu aiye, bafdada okkolottu aišše), ar tũwara Šabbator din o azomi goro.
Musar ain banga no ofan zodi Šabbator dinot ekzonore azomi gora za, toile Šabbatot ãi ekzon manušore furafuri aram goijjide hiyanolla kiyolla tũwara ãr uwore rag goror?
Tũwara dekodde mozin bisar no goijjo, bolke niyai bisar goro."

content: Zinda fani
Hetunot hodun Zeruzalemor mainše hodde, "Manuš iba hiba no ne, zare hitara marifelaibolla tuwar?"
Kintu so, ite eṛe kulasa bafe hota hor, ar honokiye hitar berudde kissu no hor; toile šašon goroya okkole ki soiyi zani faijje ze iba Messiyah?"
Kintu ite hontu hiyan to ãra zani, ar Messiyah zẽtte aibo, hiba hontu honokiye no zanibo."
Tarfore Isaye dórmogóror uṛanot šikka dedde šomot guzori hodde,

content.text: "Oi, tũwara ãre zano, ar ãi hontu iyano zano; ãi ãr nizottu nu aiyi, kintu ãre defeṛaiyede hiba soiyi, zare tũwara no zano,
ãi hibare zani, kiyollahoile ãi hibar hentu aišši, ar ãre hibaye defeṛaiye."

content: Henot hitara Isare doitto saiye, kintu honokiye hibar gat hat no de, kiyollahoile hibar ṭaim ehon o nu aiye.
Ehono, mainšor dolor butottu bout kiye hibar uwore biššaš ainne edde hodde, "Messiyah zẽtte aibo, hibaye ki ei manuššuwaye goijjede hinottuwaro beši sinno gori dehaibo?"
Foroši okkole hibar babute in okkol loi monmonadde fuinne; ar ḍõr imam okkole edde Foroši okkole hibare dori anibolla hoekzon dórmogóror faharadarore defeṛaiye.
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ehon o ãi olfo dinolla tũwarar fũwati asi, tarfore ze ãre defeṛaiye ãi hibar hãse zaiyumboi.
Tũwara ãre tuwaiba, kintu ãre no faiba; ar ãi zeṛe, heṛe tũwara ai no fariba."

content: Henot Ihudi okkole ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Iba hoṛe zaibo ze, ãra hibare tuwai no faiyum? Hiba hono ãrar Ihudi okkol zara Girikiyo okkolor fũwati šiṛašitta oi asede heṛe zaibo, edde Girikiyo okkolore šikka dibogoi?
Hibaye,

content.text: 'Tũwara ãre tuwaiba, kintu tũwara ãre tuwai no faiba, ar ãi zeṛe, heṛe tũwara ai no fariba.'

content: hoi ki hoito sadde?"
Idor šeše, ze din idor asol boro din, Isaye tiyaiyore guzori hodde,

content.text: "Ze honokiye tiraši, hite ãr hãse aiyok edde fiyok.
Hite ze ãr uwore biššaš ane, kitabor leka mozin, hitar dilot zinda halor fani baibo."

content: Ei hota hibaye Pak Ruhur babute hoiye, hitara zara hibare biššaš goijje, hitara faibo, ze Pak Ruhure ehono diya no o, kiyollahoile hẽtte o Isare mohimaola gora no o.
Hibar hota okkol funiyore dolor butottu kiye kiye hodde, "Soiyi iba he nobi."
Ar kiye hodde, "Iba Messiyah" Kintu kiye kiye hodde, "Galilottu kengori Messiyah aibo?
Kalame ki no ho ne ze Messiyah Daudor bongšottu edde ze šohorot Daud aššil, he Betlehemottu aibo?"
Endilla gori hibare loi manuš okkolor butore bag oigiyegoi.
Ar hitarar butottu hodune hibare dorito saiye, kintu honokiye hibar gat hat no de.
Ihudi neta okkolor obiššaš
Toi dormogór faharadar okkol uwafes ḍõr imam edde Foroši okkolor hãse aišše, toi hitara hitarare hodde, "Hitare tũwara nu ano kiyolla?"
Dormogór faharadar okkole zuwabe hodde, "Hibar ḍoilla endilla hota ar honokiye honodin no ho."
Henot Foroši okkole hodde, "Tũwarare o ki kufõtot loigiyegoi neki?
Šašon goroya okkol otóba Foroši okkolor butottu honokiye hitar uwore biššaš ainne ne, hono?
Kintu ei manušor dole Musar ain no zane, itarar uwore bodduwa ase."
Nikoḍomas, Foroši okkolor butore ekzon ze age Isar hãse aiššil, hibaye hitarare hodde,
"Age, hono ekzon manuš hitar nizor hota no funiyore edde hite ki gore hiyan no zaniyore ki ãrar aine bisar gore?"
Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Tũi o hono Galilor ne? Pak kitabot tuwai so, toi dekiba ze Galilottu hono nobi nu aibo."
